title: Version 1.0.0
html:
Version 1.0.0

January 14th, 2023

New Content:

  • RELEASEEEEEEE
  • Added adornment to the front of seat schematics
  • Re-added item stats

Changes:

  • Credits UI now scales properly
  • Various issues and inconsistencies in UI
  • Build Mode now listens to touch objects
  • Holding shift while in a vehicle will no-longer use stamina
  • Removed useless UI memory
  • All UI has been scaled better for Mobile
  • Interactions on Mobile have been greatly improved
  • NPC Dialog is now improved for Mobile

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed strange sideways scrolling in menu
  • Mobile can now edit text of saves
  • Fixed Mobile dragging interaction issues
  • Fixed various interaction issues

Version 1.0.1

January 14th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Mobile dragging is fixed
  • WMI rewards are now claimable

Version 1.0.2

January 14th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Cleanup for Trees and Wood increase to 15 minutes from 5 minutes
  • If Tree or Rock is unowned, will cleanup in 3 minutes
  • Temporary fix for Classic Thumbstick breaking drag (forced to Dynamic for now)
  • Users are no longer Supporter rank by default (whoops!)"

Version 1.0.3

January 14th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue with build mode
  • Cleanup fixed

Version 1.0.4

January 14th, 2023

New Content:

  • New basic tutorial implemented for new slots only

Changes:

  • Vehicles use new rotation
  • Structures slightly under the map will move back up

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed small issues.
  • Fixed shutdown UI.

Version 1.0.5

January 14th, 2023

Changes:

  • Saw now shows a % when in use

Version 1.0.6

January 15th, 2023

Changes:

  • Axe now allows you to hold down and continuously chop
  • Pickaxe now allows you to hold down and continuously mine
  • Updated descriptions for machinery to actually be descriptive
  • Decreased value of Sandstone
  • Increased value of Mythril
  • [WMI] tag is now [OG WMI]

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed small issues with saw
  • Fixed mistake that made junkyard worth more rather than less

Version 1.0.7

January 15th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added a loading UI when in the saves menu

Changes:

  • Mobile UI no-longer offsets if you have voice chat enabled.
  • Repositioned Drop on Mobile
  • Repositioned Drag on Mobile
  • Updated saw description to be more descriptive

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Title Screen buttons on Mobile
  • Fixed kick issue if you spam load button

Version 1.0.8

January 16th, 2023

New Content:

  • Build Mode now shows a marker of where your base is

Changes:

  • Reset friction on wheels back to 2 instead of 1
  • Increased initial tree decay offset
  • Made metals lighter
  • ? ? ? Magic Wand mysteriously vanished . . .
  • Changed en_us typo
  • Copper is no-longer worth the same as gold
  • Conveyor rails now use forged iron color
  • Vehicles now have a one second respawn cooldown
  • Magic Anchor Wand now has visual color indicators for anchor status
  • Headlights are now 1.5x brighter
  • Gift of Alpha Uncertainty now increases more in price than before

Bug Fixes:

  • Made magic wand hitbox larger to fix flinging
  • Fixed trees getting stuck in vehicles when instantly stopping
  • Fixed issue with pressing stop in build mode after opening a box
  • Fixed tilted conveyors messing up when placed at weird angles
  • Fixed some vehicles not having the correct license plate
